C. I. D.
P. O. REG
No. 186
Date. 22/3/12.

Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION OFFICE.
Captain Superintendent's Office,

Shanghai, March 22nd 1912.

Sir,
It is reported that some days ago Deputy Military
Governor Lu sent a telegram to Peking saying that Military
Governor Yang was holding secret conferences with the
rebels and could not be depended upon. General Yang
received a telegram from Peking on 21st instant.
It purports to have been dispatched by Yuan Shih Kai
personally, and warns General Yang that he will be
held responsible for any rebel outbreak in Shanghai.
This is believed to have been sent because of General Lu's
report.
On 20th instant General Yang received information
that a state of general unrest existed at Sungkiang.
As a result General Yang dispatched six hundred soldiers
to the scene. Some came from Woosung. They marched
to Kading, where they tried to commandeer junks to
complete the journey. The boatmen were unwilling to
let them have the junks and things looked unpleasant
for sometime. The gates of Kading City were closed.
Finally the soldiers hired some coolies to carry
their luggage and continued their journey to Sungkiang
on foot.
Eighty boxes of ammunition were sent to Nanking from
the Arsenal on 21st instant on board the steamers
Zung Z 辰字 and Siou S 宿字 .
General Yang's mother, who has been staying in
Shanghai for the past three months, left for Hupeh
her native country on 20th instant. There are many
wild rumours in circulation at the Arsenal regarding
the reason of her departure.
It is reported in rebel circles that Nieu Tih
Sung 鈕鐵生 will go to Kwangsi when he returns from
Sungkiang. He is expected back here in a day or two.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on md. March 22.

刑事侦缉处。
警务处登记号
第 186 号
日期：12年3月22日。

公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处，
警司办公室，

上海，1912年3月22日。

先生：

据报，数日前，副都督卢（Lu）致电北京，称都督杨（Yang）正与叛军举行秘密会议，不可信赖。杨都督于本月21日收到来自北京的一封电报。

该电报声称由袁世凯亲自发出，警告杨都督，他将对上海发生的任何叛乱爆发承担责任。

据信，此电是因卢都督的报告而发出的。

本月20日，杨都督获悉松江地区存在普遍的不安局势。因此，杨都督派遣六百名士兵前往该地。部分士兵来自吴淞。他们行军至嘉定，试图征用民船以完成剩余旅程。船夫不愿交出船只，局势一度显得紧张。嘉定城门随之关闭。最终，士兵们雇佣了一些苦力搬运行李，并步行继续前往松江。

本月21日，八十箱弹药由兵工厂经“辰”字轮和“宿”字轮运往南京。

杨都督的母亲过去三个月一直居住在上海，于本月20日动身返回其故乡湖北。关于她离开的原因，兵工厂内流传着许多荒诞的谣言。

据叛军方面消息，钮铁生（Nieu Tih Sung）从松江返回后将前往广西。预计他一两天内将回到此处。

您忠实的仆人，

首席探长。

警司。

于3月22日录入案卷。
